item.title: Honoring Andrew Ernst
item.description: Last Fall the radio station lost a beloved member, Andrew Ernst. He was an ever present personality, always keeping people entertained and getting new members engaged. We all admired his stories, his jokes, but most of all, his ties. He was a deeply involved member of the station with several shows such as Back & Forth, Over The Rainbow, and Lovercall. item.title: Show Spotlight: Heather Talks Hip-Hop
item.description: Hip Hop is much more than just a music genre for Heather Occhino. "Heather Talks Hip Hop" is a talk show devoted to new music and anticipating release dates of it, personal reviews of music by hip-hop artists, trending events/news regarding the genre, and more. The show was started as a way to talk about Hip Hop and its culture while gaining a great experience in radio talking about the genre. item.description: Fredonia Radio gets theatrical weekly on Friday nights with "The Jazzman Josh One Man Theatre Show." This newly crafted show is hosted by our own Staff Representative, Joshua Ribakove. According to Ribakove, The Jazzman Josh One Man Theatre Show is "a radio drama in which yours truly voice acts all the characters to old plays."
